scholarship_title: HEC Paris MBA Future Leaders of Africa Scholarship (2027 intake)
provider_organization: HEC Paris and the HEC Foundation

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Up to EUR 15,000 off MBA tuition

stipend.notes: No stipend; tuition reduction only, deducted from the last tuition instalment

application_fee.notes: The HEC MBA application fee was not checked.

country_specific_notes.note: Nigerian citizens qualify if their bachelor's or master's was obtained outside France. About 10 awards a year for English-speaking sub-Saharan Africa.

preparation_alerts: Applicants are also automatically considered for HEC Excellence and Diversity scholarships (up to 50% of tuition); combined HEC awards are capped at 50% of tuition
The need-based CMA CGM fund (average EUR 25,000) needs a separate form within one week of admission

source_urls.title: HEC Paris: MBA scholarships
source_urls.used_for: Future Leaders of Africa amount, eligibility, essay; other HEC awards and stacking cap

verification_status.verification_notes: The official page gives the award (up to EUR 15,000, 10 a year) but no essay deadline; scholarship deadlines follow the MBA application rounds, which were not read, so dates are null and status unknown. The 2024 tweet called HEC MBA scholarships 'fully funded'; the official page shows partial awards (max 50% combined, Laidlaw excepted). Aggregators mention an 18 Oct 2026 round; not confirmed. MBA admission usually expects work experience and GMAT/GRE (Excellence award uses GMAT), not recorded here.
